text:
alex: Starting a phased canary for v3.4.0 in EU-west — initial cohort 10%. Change window 01:45-03:15 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/rollouts/1764214000
deploy-bot: rollout initiated: v3.4.0 -> 10% (eu-west). cohort id: c-9243
samir: watching telemetry now, will post quick snapshots.
deploy-bot: t+3m metrics: p50=98ms p95=210ms 5xx=0.2% token-rate normal.
karen: FYI I see CPU steal and slightly elevated memory on quant hosts (eu5-edge). tagging @ops-eng for deeper look.
ops-eng: digging in, will fetch tail logs and allocation counters.
samir: t+9m p95 spikes to 520ms for a small subset of requests (edge eu5). 5xx rose to 1.5% and timeouts increased.
alex: manual pause request — hold at 10% while we triage.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 10% (manual by alex). log: "pause_by_user" action_id a-9921.
ops-eng: pulling logs now. snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T02:22:11Z] host=eu5-12 runtime_latency=498ms model=rdx-small-quant gc_pause_ms=120 kv_cache_misses=34
[2026-03-23T02:22:12Z] host=eu5-14 runtime_latency=515ms model=rdx-small-quant gc_pause_ms=135 kv_cache_misses=42
```
karen: looks like increased GC + kv cache misses on the quantized variant after tokenizer changes described in release notes: https://git.redwood/release-notes/v3.4.0
ops-eng: confirmed impact concentrated on rdx-small-quant. rdx-base and rdx-large unaffected.
release-manager: options: 1) pin eu-west canary traffic to previous stable variant v3.3.9-quant for 30m; 2) full rollback to v3.3.9 for region. Recommend (1) to buy time.
alex: agree with pin-first approach. if metrics don't recover in 12 minutes execute rollback. queueing rollback command for rapid exec.
samir: queued rollback command (standby): `/deploy rollback --service=inference --from=v3.4.0 --to=v3.3.9 --region=eu-west --reason="canary_tail_latency"`
deploy-bot: note: rollback/change of traffic >10% will execute within change window. current window open — action allowed.
ops-eng: applying routing override to redirect canary cohort to v3.3.9-quant-stable for eu-west. patch id r-6927.
deploy-bot: routing override applied: cohort c-9243 -> v3.3.9-quant-stable (eu-west).
karen: monitoring after pin. will report in 6m.
samir: t+6m after pin: p95 down to 190ms, 5xx at 0.3%, GC pause back to baseline.
alex: good signal. propose wait 8 more minutes and then resume gradual ramp to 25% with health gates (p95 <250ms and 5xx <0.6%).
release-manager: +1. we'll also add an incident note to release notes if we keep the pin/rollback path.
deploy-bot: scheduled resume: ramp -> 25% at 1764214800 unless aborted.
alex: thanks everyone, handing monitoring to ops-eng for the next 20m. ping here for any changes.
ops-eng: standing by.
end.
